description: This file defines a React hook named `useTicTacToe` that manages the state for a Tic Tac Toe game. It initializes game state, provides functions to start a new game and handle cell clicks, and offers computed status text and placeholders for game logic like win detection.

methods.name: useTicTacToe()
methods.description: A React hook managing the Tic Tac Toe game state, including initialization, handling cell clicks, starting new games, and providing current game status.
